deng-2026-edison-control-isoline.citation: Deng, Wu, Glenn and He (2026), Tropical cyclones intensify mesoscale eddy variability and accelerate Western Boundary Current instability, EarthArXiv preprint, DOI 10.31223/X59Z0V.
deng-2026-edison-control-isoline.access: Complete 28-page preprint acquired through the official Crossref text-mining link, EOF and parser integrity checked, six source pages and the native Figure S2 raster visually reviewed. Control-model black 0.4 m SSH-isoline extrema are approximate manual reads. Not peer-reviewed or direct observations.

records.period_label: Control-model panel labeled October 10, 2024; exact output hour unspecified; not observed sampling.
records.case_label: Edison control experiment; plotted 0.4 m SSH isoline; preprint model case
records.source_locator: Supplementary Figure S2, first column Control, first row October 10, 2024, PDF page 23 / supplementary page 3; continuation caption PDF page 24; eddy identification PDF pages 10-11; named LCE Figure 1 and caption PDF page 16.
records.definition: Geographic east–west bounding span read manually from visible extrema of the black 0.4 m SSH isoline around the source control-model Edison feature.
records.scope: One explicitly named preprint control-model case and source-defined isoline. Not a measured physical whole-eddy dimension, speed core or observational identity verification.
records.qualification: Preprint not accepted for publication. Control-model panel only; no counterfactual values inherited. Black 0.4 m SSH contour selected; the red 1.5-knot contour and storm tracks are excluded. Four extrema are approximate manual reads. Six native pixels per extremum and ±2 pixels on six axis anchors across 64 scenarios, with outward 25 km reporting, describe graph-reading sensitivity only. The SSH level is relative to the source background; the reviewed methods do not specify its datum. Model error, raster/axis distortion and physical-boundary uncertainty are unquantified. The model-day label is not an exact output hour, observation time, birth or lifetime. No automatic closed topology, physical footprint, diameter, radius, area, principal width, volume, state containment, ranking, annual range or seasonal playback inferred.
